note: Muscle MRI patterns in both childhood-onset and late/adult-onset SNUPN-related muscular dystrophy cohorts consistently highlight selective involvement of paravertebral, vasti, sartorius, and gracilis muscles.

evidence.text: Muscle MRI in childhood-onset SNUPN patients showed predominant impairment of paravertebral, vasti, sartorius, gracilis, peroneal, and medial gastrocnemius muscles.

source.title: Biallelic variants in SNUPN cause a limb girdle muscular dystrophy with myofibrillar-like features
source.quote: MRI showed predominant impairment of paravertebral, vasti, sartorius, gracilis, peroneal and medial gastrocnemius muscles.

evidence.text: In an adult-onset family with SNUPN variants, muscle MRI identified consistent involvement in the paravertebral, triceps brachii, sartorius, and gracilis muscles (with vasti involvement noted on imaging).

source.title: SNUPN‐Related Muscular Dystrophy: Novel Phenotypic, Pathological and Functional Protein Insights
source.quote: Muscle MRI identified involvement in the paravertebral, triceps brachii, sartorius and gracilis muscles.
